description: Discover KR/US buying questions, dated comparison evidence and exact product routes. Find validated reviewed-question text as documentation, with exact FAQ citations. Questions may ask about unsupported claims; answer/exclusion prose is not indexed as positive product evidence. Find existing KR/US buying questions by literal keywords and guide-declared example country, native currency, merchant or unit. Read-only bounded directory. Examples do not replace actual buyer selections or verify product membership, delivery, price, inventory, orders or commission. On tool failure inspect isError and structuredContent.recovery for required fields and exact product-ID sources. KR/US recovery examples are diagnostic documentation only, never buyer defaults or automatic retries.

currency.description: Exact native currency of guide examples; no exchange-rate conversion.

destinationCountry.description: Filter guide example country only, never product shipping eligibility or the actual buyer address.

query.description: Literal validated reviewed-question text, guide keywords and dated primary/option labels or SKUs of explicitly referenced products, honoring the guide option filter. Question text can ask about unsupported claims; answers are not positive feature evidence. Finds documentation only, not exact candidate membership, current stock or compatibility; not general translation.

sellerId.description: Exact guide-declared merchant or catalog merchant of an explicitly referenced guide product ID; never inferred from search text, ID prefixes or unrestricted candidate membership.

unit.description: Guide-declared comparison unit, not guessed contents or product equivalence.

name: find_buying_guides
